title: Nomos
tagline: The firm's agentic assistant — open sources, verifiable citations.

landing.headline: The lawyer decides,
landing.subtitle: Nomos organises a dossier, proposes a classement and a bordereau de pièces, and never advances a source it cannot produce. Every step stays under the lawyer's control.
landing.forWhoBody: Law firms and in-house counsel handling contentieux: première instance, appel, cassation. French employment litigation is the first practice area covered.
landing.missionBody: You dictate the instruction, Nomos assembles a visible execution plan, runs the steps in parallel, stops to ask the questions that change the legal strategy, and produces downloadable deliverables.
landing.sourcesBody: Légifrance, Judilibre, JADE, DILA: primary law and case law under Licence Ouverte 2.0. No proprietary doctrine is indexed or redistributed.
landing.controlBody: Every proposed field is editable before export. Every citation is bound to a frozen version and an exact supporting quote, in three distinct states: retrieved, machine-checked, lawyer-verified.
landing.openSourceBody: Nomos is open source. The execution plan, the attempts, the costs and the sources are durable records — inspectable and reproducible.
landing.disclaimer: Nomos does not practise law and does not replace the lawyer's analysis. Unapproved exports are stamped « projet — vérification de l'avocat requise ».

demo.ask: Sort the pièces of this employment dossier and prepare the bordereau de communication.
demo.reply: I have the 18 pièces of the Vasseur dossier. I will extract their text, qualify each one (type, date of the act, issuer), then ask you the question that drives the classement. The bordereau will be numbered chronologically and exported as a draft, to be checked before anything is sent.
demo.question: What kind of litigation is this?
demo.bordereau: Bordereau de communication de pièces — Vasseur v. SAS Orbel.docx
demo.caption: A real mission, replayed: the plan assembles, pauses for a question, then delivers.

welcome.title: Welcome to Nomos
welcome.body: One minute for the essentials: where to start a mission, where your dossiers and threads live. Replay this tour any time from your account.

newThread.title: A mission, not a chat
newThread.body: Start here. Say what you need and attach the pièces: Nomos assembles a visible plan, stops to ask the questions that matter and produces the deliverables.

agent.title: It works on its own, in view
agent.body: Describe the result you need. Nomos reads the pièces, searches Légifrance and Judilibre, drafts and checks its own work: each step appears in the thread as it happens. Every source it cites opens on the exact passage.

competence.title: Compétences, with /
competence.body: Start an instruction with / to pick a compétence: the model an acte follows, with its sections, mandatory mentions and checklist. Nomos drafts an acte only under one.

search.title: Quick access
search.body: Pages, dossiers and recent threads in a few keystrokes. Press ⌘K from anywhere.

history.title: Your threads
history.body: Every conversation is kept here, grouped by date. A thread bound to a dossier keeps its pièces, its plan and its deliverables.

dossiers.title: Dossiers
dossiers.body: One matter, its pièces: originals are kept untouched, read, qualified, then classified for the bordereau. Nothing leaves without your sign-off.

admin.title: The firm
admin.body: As an administrator, you invite the firm's members and manage their roles here.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Settings, two-factor, drafting preferences, theme and language.

done.title: Over to you
done.body: Start your first mission from the home page. The lawyer decides, the machine prepares.
